items.t: Harsh or clunky automatic shifts
items.job: Transmission software update and fluid service
items.note: If the valve body or internal parts must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Front wheel spindle nut may loosen (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front spindle nuts
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Key can come out before the car is in Park (recall)
items.job: Update or replace ignition (key fob) module
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Power steering hose can leak and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Alternator can fail suddenly (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Left cylinder head failure
items.note: Many affected cars got an extended head warranty. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying.

items.t: Power distribution module (TIPM) failure
items.job: Replace and program power distribution module (TIPM)
items.note: Rebuilt modules or a rebuild service for your own unit cost less.

items.t: Cruise control may not turn off (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: HEMI tick from failed lifters and worn camshaft
items.note: Heads come off for this job. If metal spread through the engine, replacement costs much more.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts
items.job: Extract broken manifold bolts, replace bolts and gasket
items.note: Price is per side. If the manifold is warped and must be replaced, parts cost more.

items.t: Oil filter housing and oil cooler leak
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler gaskets
items.note: The intake manifold comes off for this job. Updated aluminum housings resist cracking better.

items.t: Rear differential whine or failure
items.note: Some shops rebuild with new gears and bearings instead. Price depends on axle ratio.

items.t: Engine can be shut off out of Park with Keyless Go (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Takata airbag inflator can rupture (do-not-drive recall)
items.job: Replace airbag inflator or airbag module
items.note: Do-not-drive recall: repair is free and dealers may tow or offer a loaner. Check your VIN now.

items.t: Tire pressure sensors may not report real pressure (recall)
items.job: Reprogram or replace tire pressure monitor module
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Seat side airbags may not deploy (recall)
items.job: Repair seat side airbag wiring or replace module
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Battery cable at the starter can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Reroute and replace starter battery cable
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Fuel rail crossover hose can leak (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Instrument cluster may go blank (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Radio software could allow remote hacking (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Side curtain airbag mounting bolt loose or missing (recall)
items.job: Install or tighten side curtain airbag mounting bolt
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Engine oil cooler hoses can fail (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Car may not stay in Park (recalls)
items.job: Transmission software update and park parts repair
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Engine computer can fail and stall the car (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Wrong wheel and brake combination can rub the tire (recall)
items.job: Replace front wheels or brake parts to the correct spec
items.note: Price is per wheel. Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Instrument cluster may not show warnings (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Backup camera image may stay on (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Windshield may not be properly bonded (recall)
items.job: Remove and rebond or replace windshield
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Safety warning lights may be too dim to see (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Tire pressure sensor batteries can die early (recall)
items.note: Price is for all four sensors. Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Parking brake may be misadjusted (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.

items.t: Left rear seatback may not lock upright (recall)
items.note: Recall repair is free. Check your VIN or ask the dealer.
